BUDGET: GMVN Devprayag TRH about 1,000 (search snippet, 'on request' on chardhampackages), Chakasha Govindam avg 1,254, Batohi hotel USD 19.63. HOMESTAY: Sangam View Homestay USD 16.77 (n=1).
stay.notes: Devprayag is a small sangam town; most visitors stop 1-2 hours on the Rishikesh-Badrinath road. Tiny samples, so low confidence. Local guide estimate: 800-2,000 off season, 1,500-3,500 normal, 2,000-4,500 May-June peak (search snippet). USD->INR at 96.8 (MTFX mid-market 8 Oct 2026 = 96.82: https://www.mtfxgroup.com/tools/historical-currency-exchange-rates/usd-to-inr-rate/)
